title: Large Language Models
summary: Massive transformer-based models trained on extensive text corpora that generate, analyze, and manipulate natural language through autoregressive token prediction.
historicalContext: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) processed text word-by-word, which created a bottleneck since long-term context was lost over long sequences. This motivated Google researchers in 2017 to invent the Transformer architecture, using self-attention to process entire sequences simultaneously. Subsequent scaling led to large language models with emergent capabilities.

landmarkReferences.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
landmarkReferences.contribution: GPT-2 demonstrated that scaling language models yields zero-shot task capabilities.

landmarkReferences.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
landmarkReferences.contribution: GPT-3 showed emergent in-context learning with 175B parameters.

commonMisconceptions.wrong: Language models perform complex multi-step logical reasoning reliably in a single forward pass.
commonMisconceptions.correct: Language models predict the next token based on statistical co-occurrences. Multi-step reasoning requires explicit step-by-step guidance or chain-of-thought prompting.

analogies.text: Self-attention is like a cocktail party where every guest listens to every conversation and focuses only on people speaking about relevant topics.
analogies.limitations: Cocktail guests have conscious intentions, whereas attention heads operate via matrix transformations.

curiosityFacts: Language models do not possess an active reasoning mind; they predict the next token based on statistical co-occurrences, yet this simple next-token objective yields complex emergent capabilities.
High-dimensional word embeddings connect to geometry. In vector spaces, semantic relations behave like physical directions.
storySeeds: The field shifted from local statistical language patterns (n-grams) to continuous dense embeddings, culminating in unified generative transformer models.
Transformers displaced recurrent networks by parallelizing sequence training, enabling researchers to scale models to billions of parameters and terabytes of text.
assessmentSeeds: Contrast temperature scaling with top-k filtering during text generation decoding.
What are the advantages of tokenization strategies like Byte-Pair Encoding compared to word-level models?
professionalInsights: Deploy vLLM with PagedAttention to maximize GPU memory efficiency and enable continuous batching for high concurrent traffic.
Monitor token throughput (tokens/sec), generation latency, cost metrics, and detect semantic drift.
An enterprise copilot team migrated from commercial APIs to a self-hosted 8x7B Mixture-of-Experts model. By using vLLM, they reduced per-query latency by 40% and gained absolute data privacy.
